# Example prompts

```text
Use the git-guardian skill. I am in a merge conflict. Diagnose the state and give me the safest commands.
```

```text
Use the git-guardian skill. I want incoming changes to win for all conflicted files in PowerShell.
```

```text
Use the git-guardian skill. Update my private feature branch on latest main with the least messy history.
```

```text
Use the git-guardian skill. I accidentally reset something. Help me recover using reflog.
```

```text
Use the git-guardian skill. Cherry-pick this hotfix commit to the release branch and keep traceability.
```
